evals.expected_output: Modified auth.service.ts with NestJS Logger added (private readonly logger = new Logger(AuthService.name)). Security events logged: login attempt (debug with email, never password/passwordHash), login success (log with userId), login failure — invalid user vs wrong password should be indistinguishable in logs (warn with email only). logout logged at log level with userId. accessToken must never appear in logs. Logging Summary notes excluded fields.

Modified orders.ts using req.log (pino-http bound logger). GET list: debug with userId and result count. POST: debug on entry with userId and item count (not full body); log on success with orderId and userId; warn on validation failure with error message. DELETE: log with orderId and userId (destructive action). Errors passed to next() — notes that the central error middleware should log them. No new pino import needed since req.log is already available.

Fixed users.service.ts addressing: Logger() missing context → Logger(UsersService.name); all console.log replaced with NestJS logger calls; findAll dumps full user array including sensitive fields → demote to debug with count only; create logs plain password → must never log password, log only email and resulting userId; catch block logs 'error!' → error with err.stack and context; delete is a destructive action → add log with userId. Logging Summary explains every change and calls out the password exposure as a security fix.
